## ReferenceWire type

Wire form of a reference: the payload of a `reference` control record.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ReferenceWire =
  | {
      readonly resource: string
      readonly form: 'identity'
      readonly cardinality: 'one'
      readonly id: WireValue
      readonly container?: ReferenceWire
    }
  | {
      readonly resource: string
      readonly form: 'selector'
      readonly cardinality: 'one'
      readonly selector: ObjectSelectorWire
      readonly container?: ReferenceWire
    }
  | {
      readonly resource: string
      readonly form: 'identity'
      readonly cardinality: 'many'
      readonly entries: readonly ReferenceWire[]
    }
  | {
      readonly resource: string
      readonly form: 'selector'
      readonly cardinality: 'many'
      readonly selector: CollectionSelectorWire
      readonly container?: ReferenceWire
    }
```

**References:** [WireValue](./contracts.wirevalue.md)<!-- -->, [ReferenceWire](./contracts.referencewire.md)<!-- -->, [ObjectSelectorWire](./contracts.objectselectorwire.md)<!-- -->, [CollectionSelectorWire](./contracts.collectionselectorwire.md)

## Remarks

`form` and `cardinality` are both always present, so every variant is discriminated by the pair.
